name: The World Within the Empty Cup

body.label: Target
body.html: Self and up to two willing allies within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Burn 1 additional Action Die. Each target suppresses one ordinary magical Condition until the start of your next turn and reduces its next incoming magical Damage by 1 during that time.

surges.html: One target may move 2 units toward you; self moves freely.
One target suppresses a Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Offering
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind one target. Trigger: it resists an ordinary magical Condition with a successful Defense. Echo: reveal its source's occupied space if within 5 units and not behind solid cover.
